practicals.title: Practical-1
content: Understanding basic tools for creating HTML pages along with
structure

practicals.title: Practical-2
content: Create HTML page that contains basic HTML tags.

practicals.title: Practical-3
content: Create HTML page that contains your basic details for eg, 1) Name
2) Enrollment 3) Branch4) College name 5) Address

practicals.title: Practical-4
content: Create HTML page that includes image and its description with
different background color also include a paragraph in it.

practicals.title: Practical-5
content: Create a web page, which include different type of lists using
HTML List tags(includes nested list and types of attributes).

practicals.title: Practical-6
content: Create HTML page to include hyperlinks (3-4) which redirects to
your subject syllabus webpage.

practicals.title: Practical-7
content: Create a web page which includes definitions of any 10 technical
words using definition list

practicals.title: Practical-8
content: Create a table in a web page

practicals.title: Practical-9
content: Create a timetable of class in webpage using table tags.

practicals.title: Practical-10
content: Create a menu of a restaurant / hotel using list and tables on
webpage

practicals.title: Practical-11
content: Create a basic form by using any two inputs and buttons (login
form).

practicals.title: Practical-12
content: Create a registration form with different inputs, text box and
buttons.

practicals.title: Practical-13
content: Create a survey form with different inputs, textbox, dropdown menu
and multiple select option.

practicals.title: Practical-14
content: Create a web page which includes audio and embed a video of
YouTube tags of HTML.

practicals.title: Practical-15
content: Create a web page with different CSS, which is Internal, Inline and
External.

practicals.title: Practical-16
content: Create a web page using CSS, use google fonts in paragraphs and
also use external style sheet to style the content on web page.

practicals.title: Practical-17
content: Develop a web page using CSS to create a timetable for the class
using different background, text, border style.

practicals.title: Practical-18
content: Develop a webpage of an Image gallery using CSS (Height and
width of the images should be equal and margin should be set
properly.)

practicals.title: Practical-19
content: Develop a basic webpage to understand the concept of gradient, text
effect and animation using CSS.

practicals.title: Practical-20
content: Develop a webpage with a navigation bar (horizontal or vertical)
using CSS.

practicals.title: Practical-21
content: Design a website for Marwadi University containing a description
of all the courses offered. It should also contain general information
about the college such as its campus and facilities provided by it.
Total Hours 29
